# Acme Robotics — Employee Handbook (Excerpt)

## Working hours

The standard work week at Acme Robotics is 40 hours, typically Monday through
Friday. Core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00 local time, during which
employees are expected to be reachable.

## Paid time off

Full-time employees accrue 20 days of paid vacation per year, plus 10 paid public
holidays. Unused vacation of up to 5 days may be carried over into the following
calendar year.

## Remote work

Employees may work remotely up to 3 days per week. Fully remote arrangements
require approval from a department head and are reviewed every 6 months.

## Equipment budget

Each new engineer receives a one-time equipment budget of 2000 US dollars for a
laptop and accessories. An additional annual learning budget of 1000 US dollars
may be spent on courses, books, or conferences.

## Expense reimbursement

Approved business expenses are reimbursed within 14 days of submission. Receipts
are required for any expense above 25 US dollars.
